prompt: To estimate how many hours students sleep, a principal randomly selects $4$ of the school's $30$ homerooms and surveys EVERY student in those four rooms. What sampling method is this?
hint: Stratified takes SOME from EVERY group. Cluster takes ALL from SOME groups. Which happened?

hints.text: Stratified takes SOME from EVERY group. Cluster takes ALL from SOME groups. Which happened?
Only 4 of the 30 homerooms were picked, and everyone in those 4 was surveyed.
All students from a few randomly chosen groups: a cluster sample, choice B.

explanation: The homerooms are the clusters. The principal randomly chose a few clusters and surveyed everyone inside them.
A stratified sample would instead take a few students from EVERY homeroom.
Choosing whole groups is a cluster sample, done mainly for convenience. Choice B.

alternativeExplanations.title: Why it is not an SRS
steps: In an SRS of students, any two students have the same chance of being chosen together.
Here, two students in the same homeroom are always chosen together, and two in different unchosen rooms never are.
That dependence is the mark of a cluster sample.
